4.5 Stars - Loving these!

Our larger stand-up Frigidaire freezer bit the dust after only 6 years (& the Frigidaire refrigerator failed at 5mo) - & research indicated chest freezers were generally better - so we picked up a new 7.2 cu ft Hisense Chest Freezer locally. It came with 2 baskets - but being use to the better organization capabilities of our larger stand-up freezer - i thought an additional basket(s) would help.

After research indicated purchasing additional OEM Hisense baskets was unlikely (???) - measurements indicated this OEM GE basket should fit. Cudos to GE for offering these - well done GE!!!

So, we ordered 1 to try it. Though not as nice or HD as the OEM Hisense baskets that came with the freezer - they are 'good enough.'

Further measurements indicated another GE basket would fit if alternated with the Hisense baskets. It does.

fyi - with more than 2-3 baskets - removal maybe / is needed to get below them.

4 baskets works GREAT for us.

Basket Photos (in a Hisense 7.2 cu ft Chest Freezer) are: #1: 2-Hisense; #2: 2-Hisense + 1 GE; #3: 2-Hisense + 2 GE (alternated to fit). The GE's are the thinner wire - & hang slightly lower.
